description: Nerdy keeps the understanding you want to remember. Plan a learning pathway, learn one concept at a time with your AI tutor, and save the explanation that clicked after you explicitly agree. Return in a new conversation to revise from your saved Kites, record recall evidence, and see when to come back. You can also clarify and approve corrections to a specific Kite or create a compact chapter Review Sheet. Nerdy stores your learning record and source references; it does not receive source files or import full chat history. AI-authored content can be wrong, and grounding labels do not verify accuracy. Requires a Nerdy account.

defaultPrompt: Teach me one concept and help me save the understanding that clicked in Nerdy.
Use Nerdy to quiz me on something I have learned.
Plan a Nerdy learning pathway for my goal.
